processNotes: Formed components may be prepared in advance; the demonstration does not prescribe dimensions or manufacturing settings.

The BOM lists 4 EA seat stays but does not establish their individual placement. Fork attachment hardware and mating details are not supplied, so the final view does not claim a secured fork assembly.
The paint quantity is the BOM allowance, not a specified application amount or finish schedule.
variantNotes: Black and red variants are listed in sizes 44, 48, 52, 58, 60 and 62. This recipe remains specific to Black, 58.
All listed black variants use 8.00 OZ of Paint - Black, product 492; all listed red variants substitute 8.00 OZ of Paint - Red, product 493.
The supplied direct BOMs otherwise list the same component IDs and quantities across variants. Size-specific geometry or adjustments are not supplied and should not be inferred.
The supplied descriptive text concerns the Black, 48 variant; it is not a specification for the representative frame.

revisions.description: Initial controlled issue for product introduction; established the component list and work-center sequence.
Clarified identification of Top Tube; retained the source part number in the point-of-use checklist.
Reformatted shop-floor copies for clearer numbered steps and consolidated inspection comments.
Standardized work-center hand-off notes and separated preparation time from hands-on labor.
Reordered the Chain Stays receiving check ahead of kit staging; added a missing-part hold point.
Moved variant-selection notes ahead of the first operation to reduce wrong-kit changeovers.
Aligned component count checks with the bill of materials and removed a duplicate sign-off box.
Released the illustrated workstation edition: Frame component arrangement and fork. Matched numbered component legends to the operating steps and adopted the Manufacturing Hub document layout.

100091.title: Frame component arrangement and fork
guidance: Arrange Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301), Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828), Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377) and Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019) in an assumed frame jig. See the schematic arrangement in illustration 100091.
Stage 2.00 EA Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812) and 4.00 EA Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985) with the frame. Their exact placement, especially for the four seat stays, is not specified.

Position 1.00 EA LL Fork (Product Number FK-1639) near the front of the frame for the demonstration, as in illustration 100091. Do not claim a secured attachment: mating hardware and details are not supplied.
